channel.title: Block Club Chicago - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Block Club Chicago (blockclubchicago.org)

item.title: After Years Of Construction, CTA Opens Door To Redevelopment Near Clark And Roscoe
item.description: Requests for proposals signal the next phase of the Red and Purple Line Modernization project in Lakeview.

item.title: Chicago Prepares Development Plan For Industrial Zone With Priority For Water And Wetland
item.description: Restoring neglected waterways of the Southeast Side are major challenge.

item.title: Chicago Recorded Fewest Murders In 60 Years In 2025, Bucking Trump’s ‘Murder Capital’ Insult
item.description: Chicago ended 2025 with 416 murders, according to preliminary data, a 29 percent drop from last year. Here's why the mayor, top cop and experts say violent crime is down.

item.title: Humboldt Park Sub Shop Owner Deported But Family Vows ‘This Is Not The End’
item.description: The beloved business owner's family held an emergency press conference before his flight Thursday, calling on elected officials to do more to protect families being torn apart and continue raising awareness of the "flawed immigration system."

item.title: McCormick & Schmick’s Closes In The Loop
item.description: Parent company Landry’s Restaurant Group opted not to renew its lease for the Wacker Drive location, the steak and seafood chain’s only Chicago outpost.

item.title: Beverly Businesses Damaged After Car Crashes Into Building On New Year’s Day
item.description: A 41-year-old man has been charged in connection with the early-morning crash, police said. Beverly Phono Mart, FoundHERS Suite and Ephemera Gallery are closed until further notice.

item.title: Chicagoans March Against Trump’s Removal Of Venezuelan Leader: ‘Solely About Oil And Power’
item.description: Hundreds marched Downtown Saturday to denounce President Donald Trump's military operation in Venezuela, while Venezuelans living in Chicago described "mixed reactions" to the ouster of the country's leader, Nicholás Maduro.

item.title: CTA State And Lake Station Closing Monday For 3 Years As Rebuild Begins
item.description: The new State and Lake station is set to debut in 2029 featuring modern amenities and a glass canopy. Trains will not stop at the station during the duration of construction.

item.title: Chicago Shifting Back To Warmer Weather This Week With Highs In The 50s
item.description: Wednesday and Thursday could see temperatures in the mid-50s, up to 20 degrees higher than early January averages.

item.title: Bears To Play Packers In Playoff Game At Soldier Field As Cinderella Season Continues
item.description: A third matchup against the hated Packers will be the latest dramatic chapter in the Bears' storybook season that has taken the city by storm.
